title: The current entry on our blog Innovation@ETH-Bibliothek reveals how scientific libraries can help researchers with the long-term storage of research data. It discusses possible distributions of responsibilities based on ETH-Bibliothek’s services and experiences as a service-provider for ETH Zurich.
